## Template checklist

Skip this section if the pull request does not touch `templates/`.

- [ ] The file is `templates/<id>.json` and the `id` is new, lowercase, with dashes
- [ ] I raised `version` because I changed an existing template
- [ ] `python3 scripts/publish_templates.py --check --skip-manifest` passes on my machine
- [ ] I did not edit `release.json` or `changelog.txt`; the release bot updates them after merge
- [ ] Every default text is my own or free to use, with no brand names or people I have no rights to
- [ ] I opened the template in my studio, filled the slots and rendered it
- [ ] Code scenes, if any, use only the composition contract: no network, storage, navigation or external media
- [ ] Preview frames or a short render are attached below
